info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Tips-v1-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Tips API provides insights and guidance on delivering food efficiently and effectively. By utilizing this API, delivery personnel and businesses can access curated tips that enhance delivery practices and improve customer satisfaction. Typical users include delivery drivers looking for best practices and restaurant owners aiming to support their staff with valuable delivery insights. This endpoint serves as a key resource for improving overall delivery performance in the food service industry.

get.summary: Retrieve the tip details for deliveries.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the tip information associated with deliveries. It is useful for understanding what additional compensation can be provided to delivery personnel.
